description: Calculate grass seed weight (lb and kg) and whole bags for a new lawn using OSU Extension species presets or a custom seeding rate.

area.description: Known lawn area (ft² in us, m² in metric).

bagWeight.description: Bag weight (lb in us, default 7; kg in metric, default 5).

customRateLbPer1000Ft2.description: Optional custom seeding rate in lb per 1,000 ft² (overrides species preset).

length.description: Lawn length (ft in us, m in metric). Provide length+width OR area.

species.description: Species preset: tf (Tall fescue), kbg (Kentucky bluegrass), ff (Fine fescues), pr (Perennial ryegrass).

width.description: Lawn width (ft in us, m in metric).

name: calculate_grass_seed
title: Grass Seed Calculator
